title: Elite Status Extension
scenario: An email says your elite status can be extended after updating details through a button.

answers.A: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.B: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.C: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.
answers.D: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.

explanation: Elite Status Extension: the trap is to turn convenience into a device or network security risk. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Status updates are visible in your official profile.
